text: XXXX Affiliate Mortage Collection agency assumed collections/payments for XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXXXXXX XXXX. The book keeping was by hand with pencil and paper and incorrect. My payments were mailed certified on time for months to assure correction application of my payments but were still applied and reported incorrectly to all 3 credit Bureaus. I have attmepted disputes via certified mail XXXX and XX/XX/XXXX directly to Affiliate Mortage. There is no singned contractual agreement or obligation to Affiliate Mortage or even a signed late policy. They have turned the mortages back to the original XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXXXXXX, but refuse to correct the incorrect reporting that wrecked my credit. And, they are reporting different dates between the 3 credit bureaus. My loan has never been late, and has never been reported to the credit bureaus, EXCPET, when affiate got it and reported it late for 6 months!!!! Affiliate Mortgage did not furnish the credit bureaus with the required disclosure, within the period required by law. They are required by federal law to place a notice of dispute on my account within 30 days of my dispute. Therefore, they have violated the Fair Credit Reporting Act, Section 623 ( a ) ( 3 ) and/or the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act Section 807 ( 8 ).
